lines.zh: 我在草茎之间一蹦一蹦。
lines.en: I hop from stem to stem.
I do not jump high, but I jump often.

lines.zh: 我落在叶子上，又弹起来。
lines.en: I land on a leaf and spring off again.

lines.zh: 我沿着草丛边缘往前移。
lines.en: I work along the edge of the grass.

lines.zh: 我一跳就是半个身子远。
lines.en: One hop carries me half a body length.

lines.zh: 我从这片草跳到那片草。
lines.en: I hop from this clump to that one.
I move sideways along the ground.
I stop on a blade and sway.

lines.zh: 我的后腿一撑就出去了。
lines.en: My hind legs push off and I am gone.
I climb a thin stem.
I look for a way between the blades.
I misjudge a hop and land on bare earth.

lines.zh: 我马上爬起来，钻回草里。
lines.en: I scramble up and back into the grass.
I hop along the lake shore.
I hop onto a fallen log and off again.
I stop and turn my antennae.
I cling to the back of a blade.
I am almost the color of the grass.
I tuck in and hold still.
The grass here is thick enough.
I listen to everything around me.
My hind legs are folded in.
The wind sways the grass and I sway with it.
I am small; you will hardly see me.
I groom my forelegs.
I am waiting for quiet.
The sun falls on this patch of grass.
I shift half a body.
There is chirring in this grass.
I look at you through the blades.

lines.zh: 你比我大了不知多少倍。
lines.en: You are countless times my size.
I withdrew a very little.
Your shadow darkens the grass.
If you move, I am ready to jump.
I cling to the blade and keep still.
Do not bend your head down to look.
I can see your eye.
One step closer and I am gone.
As long as you stand, I will not jump.
One jump and I am gone.
I curled myself as small as I go.
I tuck every leg in.
My hind leg keeps twitching.
I roll over and get up.
That was heavy for me.
I squeeze into a gap in the grass.
I stayed hidden a long while.
What is that? Can it be eaten?
I shift toward it.
Leaves are what I eat.
I went up and tried a bite.
The taste is a little off.
Let me get a closer look first.
I am not gnawing this.

lines.zh: 把叶子放到我够得着的地方。
lines.en: Set the leaf where I can reach it.
I have backed off again.
The touch rolls me over.
I spring away at once.
That was huge to me.
I have burrowed into the grass.
My leg has lost some push.
I rolled over and got up again.
I press flat to the earth.
Do not tread on this patch.
I hide under a leaf.

lines.zh: 我被撞得一跳，翅膀张开。
lines.en: The bump makes me hop, wings spread.

lines.zh: 这个季节，草里都是叫声。
lines.en: In this season the grass is full of calls.
I hop toward that sound.
We are almost flat against the same blade.
My wings quiver fast.
This patch of grass is enough for us.

lines.zh: 之后我会把卵放进土里。
lines.en: Afterwards I will put eggs in the soil.
I gave two or three calls.
We hide under the same leaf.
This spell passes very quickly.
The grass sways again.
I cannot move this.
This is not for eating.
It is bigger than my whole body.
I hop onto it.
I hop off again.
I gnawed off a little.
Too hard to bite into.
I push it two steps.
I hop away and forget it.
I freeze with my antennae pointed that way.
My hind legs are set to jump.
This grass is not enough cover.
I do not intend to fight it.
I need only one direction.

lines.zh: 我听见了草被压的声音。
lines.en: I hear grass being pressed.
I glance that way.
Hold half a breath longer.
I slide off the tip of a leaf.
My wings tremble once.

lines.zh: 你向左，我就往右边草里钻。
lines.en: You go left and I burrow right.
I hop, then stop, then hop.
I stay in the grass.
The blades hide me.
I have moved to another stem.
I do not jump far; I jump off to the side.

lines.zh: 你的脚步震得草叶乱抖。
lines.en: Your steps shake the grass blades.
I shrink further in.
I know this grass far better.
I lie along the vein and watch.
You have not left, so I will not move first.
There is a gap under the blades.
I hop up and bump into it.
I can hardly hurt anything.
I kick out with a hind leg.

lines.zh: 这一下轻得像碰了一下。
lines.en: That was as light as a touch.
I bite once and flee.
I spring aside.
I can hardly stand my ground.
I hop back into the grass.
This is not what I am good at.

lines.zh: 我蹬了一脚，自己却翻了。
lines.en: I kick out and tumble instead.
I touch it with an antenna.
A tiny insect appears on a blade.
I land in the lakeside grass.
The grass here is good.
I groom my antennae first.
The grass was so thick it took me a while.

lines.zh: 我跳上一根高一点的茎。
lines.en: I hop onto a taller stem.
I hear herdmates calling.
This is newly grown grass.

lines.zh: 我落在一片宽阔的叶子上。
lines.en: I land on a broad leaf.
I push out of the grass and stop on the earth.
I have just come from the lake shore.
It is warmer here than where I was.
The heat scorches me into a jump.

lines.zh: 我从草上掉下来，翻了两个身。
lines.en: I fall from the grass and tumble twice.

lines.zh: 水把我整个包住，我乱蹬。
lines.en: Water closes over me and I kick wildly.
The blast flings me far.
Some force pins me to the grass.
Hunger leaves me unable to jump.
The thunder flattens me to the ground.
There is no grass and nothing to grip.
